title: PMs Don't Need to Code, but They Do Need to Understand

title: How healthcare tech teams innovate while balancing speed and security
partialText: Healthcare can be a tough space for innovation: Speed often feels at odds with the high-compliance environment. How do you find a balance? We asked them in a new research study and sat down with a Merck executive and two of our own developers.

title: Can’t touch the DOM? Reach for :has() to style any element
